correctness.rationale: Every nonsquarefree monic cubic uniquely equals (T-r)²(T-s). Requiring f+h nonsquarefree at x, write d=x-r; d=0 contributes q only if discriminant Delta=0, while d!=0 yields a quadratic in x with discriminant 4(2u d³+u²d²+Delta). Character sum and substitution d=uz/2 give B=q-1+sum_(z!=0) chi(z³+z²+t)+q 1_(t=0). The character-sum specializations give B=2q-2 for t=0 and the other singular formula at t=-4/27 when char!=3. Else y²=z³+z²+t gives elliptic trace. Averaging over w amounts to averaging over t; standard quadratic character correlation plus exact collision count M=2q-5-chi(-3)+1_(char3) prove mean q and variance 2q-6-chi(-3)+1_(char3)-1/q. Direct independent finite enumeration of every nonsquarefree cubic and quadratic shift over F3,F5,F7,F11 for selected u,v matched profiles and moments. The formulas for nonprime odd prime powers rest on the field-character proof, not prime-field experiments.
